newsitem.title: UK: Wilcon expects much better results for year.
newsitem.headline: Wilcon expects much better results for year.

text.p: Housebuilder Wilson (Connolly) Holdings Plc said on Friday it expected to report improved results for the year.
"Our current position is looking much brighter than 12 months ago," chairman Lynn Wilson told the group's annual general meeting.

"Barring any unforeseen developments in the national economy, I expect to be able to report much better results for the year, although recovery will be, as usual, significantly more marked in the second half," he said.
In March the company, which trades as Wilcon, reported a 17 percent increase in pre-tax profits to 26.4 million stg for 1996.
"The recovery in the housing market has been well publicised and is more solidly based than other 'false dawns'," he said.
He warned, however, that while the recovery has been strong in the Southeast, and particularly in London, it has been weaker in the Midlands and no recovery at all has been seen in the North.
"It appears that the so-called North-South divide has, for the time being at least, returned".
Wilson added that he hoped purchaser confidence would be maintained once uncertainty surrounding next week's general election disappears.
